summary: The predicate `IsOneLoopRGSolution` is public with an unexposed body and no `_def`/intro/elim lemma, so downstream consumers can neither establish nor use it — which makes the headline uniqueness theorem unusable outside this file, and leaves the file's own witness incomposable with its own consumers. `landauScaleSq` also lacks the one lemma that backs its docstring.
